clue.text: Gloomy deputy-head getting dismissed

indicators.note: the head of the word deputy is its first letter, as the clue's hyphenated phrase spells out

parts.note: someone dismissed is thrown out, or ejected

explanation.surface: A downcast second-in-command after losing their post as deputy head.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Deputy-head' reads as a school post, but it means the head (first letter) of 'deputy', D.
explanation.definitionFit: Dejected is a synonym of gloomy: low in spirits and downhearted.

clue.text: Quit? That wouldn't be right!

definitions.meaning: past tense of quit: departed or went away
the opposite side to right, describing a direction or hand

explanation.surface: Someone wonders whether resigning would be the wrong thing to do.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both the past of 'go away' (departed) and the side opposite to right, a pun on 'right' meaning correct.

clue.text: Hound the fool appearing in a flutter

indicators.note: the fool is shown appearing inside the flutter, so one piece goes within the other

parts.note: a flutter is British slang for a small bet
an ass is a fool

explanation.surface: A foolish person turns up having placed a small wager on a race.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A flutter' is everyday British slang for a small bet.
explanation.definitionFit: A basset is a short-legged breed of hound.

clue.text: Long holding up thank-you letter

indicators.note: the yearning word holds the other piece within it

parts.note: to long for something is to aspire to it

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word for thanks is read from the bottom upwards

parts.note: ta is informal British for thank you

explanation.surface: Someone yearning delays writing a note of thanks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Up' reverses the informal British thanks, read bottom to top in a down clue. The definition is fair: an aspirate is the breathed sound represented by the letter H.
explanation.definitionFit: An aspirate is the breathy h sound, and by extension the letter h that represents it.

clue.text: Improvement made in note design

indicators.note: design suggests the letters of these words are arranged into a new pattern

explanation.surface: A musical note's design has been made better.
explanation.definitionFit: An emendation is a correction or improvement, especially to a text.

clue.text: A little cavern always most spectacular in spring

indicators.note: A little says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: A small cave is always at its finest in springtime.
explanation.definitionFit: Vernal describes things belonging to springtime, such as flowers at their seasonal peak.

clue.text: A number in calm surroundings provide music

indicators.note: the calm word forms surroundings round the other letters

parts.note: serene means calm
D is the Roman numeral for five hundred, a number

explanation.surface: A song performed in tranquil settings gives musical accompaniment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A number' looks like a song but gives A plus D, the Roman numeral 500, placed inside SERENE.
explanation.definitionFit: To serenade is to sing or play music, typically to a loved one beneath a window.

clue.text: Remove the tax

definitions.meaning: to cut out or take away, as a surgeon might
a duty levied on goods made at home

explanation.surface: An instruction to abolish the levy.
explanation.definitionFit: Excise means both to cut out surgically and a duty charged on home-produced goods.

clue.text: When one may see the adder?

definitions.text: When one may see the adder?

parts.words: When one may see the adder?
parts.note: an adder is a snake seen in the warm season, but also a person who adds, and one who adds up totals is a person who does sums

explanation.surface: A wildlife question about when snakes are out and about.
explanation.walkthrough: The adder looks like the snake, out basking in warm months; it is also one who adds, and someone who does sums gives the same word.
explanation.definitionFit: Adders are active in the warm season, and a person who sums figures is also a calculator of totals, matching both readings.

clue.text: Others are at ease

definitions.meaning: the remainder, the ones left over

explanation.surface: The other people are relaxed.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both the remainder of a group and to relax in repose.

clue.text: The eccentric got in, since causing division

indicators.note: eccentric means odd or off-centre, so these letters are set out in an unusual order

explanation.surface: An odd character has been admitted and has stirred up conflict ever since.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The' is a link here; the anagram uses only GOT IN SINCE.
explanation.definitionFit: Sectioning is the act of cutting something into parts, a kind of division.

clue.text: A watercourse, and the way it can absorb an artist

indicators.note: the outer pair of pieces can take in the artist between them

parts.note: ST is the abbreviation for street, a way
taken as written
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist

explanation.surface: A stream, and the route along which a painter might be carried.
explanation.walkthrough: The 'way' is a street, as in a road name, and the artist is a Royal Academician, the crossword's usual painter.
explanation.definitionFit: A strait is a narrow channel of water joining two seas.

clue.text: Catastrophic conflict of a body of serving men over old fellow

indicators.note: in a down clue, over means the first pieces stand above the rest

parts.note: RM stands for the Royal Marines, a body of servicemen
aged means old
a don is a fellow of a university college

explanation.surface: A regiment's veterans recall a terrible war.
explanation.walkthrough: RM is the Royal Marines, Britain's naval infantry; a don is a university fellow.
explanation.definitionFit: Armageddon is the prophesied final battle, used for any devastating war.

clue.text: Costal defences repaired as well as may be

indicators.note: repaired suggests the letters are mended back into a different form

explanation.surface: Defences along the shore are mended as well as they can be.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Costal' (of the ribs) is printed for 'Coastal'; 'may be' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Barriers built along the shoreline protect the coast from the sea, so they are coastal defences.

clue.text: Material for an American lawyer to screen

parts.note: DA is a district attorney, a US prosecutor
to mask is to hide or screen

explanation.surface: Fabric an American attorney uses to hide something.
explanation.definitionFit: Damask is a rich patterned fabric, often silk or linen.

clue.text: Offer information about legal wrong in the Norwegian parliament

indicators.note: the informing word goes about the legal one, round it

parts.note: to sing is slang for informing to the police
a tort is a civil wrong in law

explanation.surface: Someone gives evidence about a civil wrong in Norway's legislature.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sing' is underworld slang for informing to the police; it goes round TORT.
explanation.definitionFit: The Storting is Norway's national legislature.

clue.text: The city's failing to accept directions

indicators.note: the failing takes the directions inside it

parts.note: a vice is a moral failing
E and N are compass points, east and north

explanation.surface: A city's weakness is its refusal to follow instructions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Directions' here are compass points, E and N.
explanation.definitionFit: Venice is an Italian city built on lagoon islands.

clue.text: The ordinary person can be very mean

indicators.note: can be signals the letters of the next words could form something else when rearranged

explanation.surface: An observation that the average person may be terribly stingy.
explanation.definitionFit: Everyman is the typical person in the street, the common man.

clue.text: Frame some revolutionary work

parts.note: a red is a communist, a revolutionary
an act is a deed, a piece of work

explanation.surface: Some subversive work is put in a frame.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Frame' is the verb: to put words into form, draft or edit.
explanation.definitionFit: To redact is to draft or put into a written form, so to frame a text.

clue.text: Non-belligerent winger getting involved in fighting?

definitions.text: Non-belligerent winger getting involved in fighting?

parts.words: Non-belligerent winger getting involved in fighting?
parts.note: a peaceful bird, the symbol of pacifists, imagined stepping into a boxing arena

explanation.surface: A peace-loving footballer from the flank gets into a brawl.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Winger' suggests a sports player but means a bird; a peace-symbol bird in a boxing ring gives the name of a pigeon.
explanation.definitionFit: This pigeon is a kind of dove, the bird that symbolises peace, and the boxing arena echoes the first part.

clue.text: Ride unhappily around on being pressed

indicators.note: the jumbled letters go around the small word on
unhappily signals the letters of ride are in a disturbed state

explanation.surface: Someone rides miserably, feeling under pressure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Unhappily' scrambles the riding word to IRED, which then goes 'around' the little word.
explanation.definitionFit: Clothes that have been pressed are smoothed with a hot iron.

clue.text: Taking a breather, the leading newsman suddenly thrust forward

parts.note: a lung is the organ one breathes with
ED is short for editor, the senior figure at a newspaper

explanation.surface: Pausing for air, the chief journalist abruptly lurched ahead.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Taking a breather' suggests a rest; 'Taking' is only a link, and the breather is the breathing organ.
explanation.definitionFit: To lunge is to make a sudden forward movement, as in fencing.

clue.text: The individual who really wants more time

definitions.meaning: a person who yearns or craves

explanation.surface: A person who badly wants extra time.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who yearns is one who longs, and the comparative of long means of greater duration.

clue.text: Transport for merchandise of superior type

definitions.meaning: a railway freight service carrying products

explanation.surface: A freight service that is high class.
explanation.definitionFit: A freight railway service carries merchandise; split differently, the letters make a fine breed or variety.

clue.text: Coves wanting recognition of merit

explanation.surface: Small inlets that go unrewarded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Coves' could be old slang for chaps, but here it means inlets; laurel wreaths were a classical honour.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both curved inlets of coast and laurel crowns given as honours.

clue.text: A footballer's sponsor

definitions.meaning: a defender, a player positioned behind the forwards

explanation.surface: Someone funding a soccer player.
explanation.definitionFit: A defensive player in football has this name, and to support someone is to give them this.

clue.text: Sailors about old-fashioned enough for celebrity

indicators.note: the sailors go about the archaic word, surrounding it

parts.note: RN is the Royal Navy
enow is an archaic form of enough

explanation.surface: Naval men, in a quaint way, are famous enough.
explanation.walkthrough: RN is the Royal Navy, Britain's navy; ENOW is an old word for enough.
explanation.definitionFit: Renown is fame, the state of being celebrated.

clue.text: Modifications made to the car for a deified ruler

indicators.note: modifications made to these words alter their letter order

explanation.surface: Customising a vehicle for a god-king.
explanation.definitionFit: A theocrat rules as god or in god's name, so may be revered as divine.
